program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-border a b)
      (let* ((r1 (min (first a) (first b)))
             (r2 (max (first a) (first b)))
             (c1 (min (second a) (second b)))
             (c2 (max (second a) (second b))))
        (filter (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) r1) (= (first p) r2)
                                (= (second p) c1) (= (second p) c2)))
                (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([color (in-list (remove-duplicates (map third (filter (lambda (cell) (not (= (third cell) 0))) (grid-cells g)))))])
      (let ((pts (find-color g color)))
        (if (and (= (length pts) 2)
                 (not (= (first (first pts)) (first (second pts))))
                 (not (= (second (first pts)) (second (second pts)))))
            (paint-cells out (rect-border (first pts) (second pts)) color)
            out)))))
